narrative.overview: ContextDrop lives overlaid on arbitrary host Ruby on Rails applications. Because it must remain unmistakably distinct from whatever host page lies beneath it without creating visual noise, its aesthetic combines warm archival paper surfaces (#faf9f6) and deep obsidian ink (#111318) with two high-precision instrument accents: Pin Vermilion (#c2410c) for physical pin-drop affordances and Inspector Cobalt (#1d4ed8) for live DOM geometry and layer disambiguation. Every control is compact, draggable, and responsive. When the user activates the top-left Pin selector, the chatbox collapses into a compact floating bar with live DOM breadcrumbs while a cursor-tracked pushpin and layer popover allow surgical disambiguation of overlapping and deeply nested HTML elements.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric Pushpin Silhouette: Pin triggers and markers use a directional teardrop/corner radius (11px 11px 11px 3px) pointing toward the anchored coordinate.
Warm Paper over Arbitrary Grounds: Warm alabaster (#faf9f6) and recessed stone (#f1efea) prevent the widget from blending into standard cold-white (#ffffff) or slate SaaS backgrounds.
Authored 1.75px Stroke Iconography: All icons use inline SVG paths with 1.75px stroke width and round caps/joins—never Unicode symbols or emoji stand-ins.
Tabular Measurement Numerals: All bounding-box dimensions (200×44), layer counters (2/5 layers), and timestamps enforce font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Accent Rule
rules.body: Pin Vermilion (#c2410c) means 'pick or pin an element'; Inspector Cobalt (#1d4ed8) means 'active DOM geometry or layer selection.' Never swap them or use either for decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The Earned Monospace Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is used exclusively for DOM tag names, CSS selectors, ancestor paths, and pixel dimensions—never as a decorative voice for prose or buttons.

dos: Do keep all widget styles strictly scoped inside the Shadow DOM (WIDGET_SHADOW_STYLES) or inline on [data-context-drop-ui] overlay elements so host application CSS is never mutated.
Do intercept pointerdown, mousedown, mouseup, click, and wheel in the capture phase during Pin Mode so underlying host links, buttons, and scroll containers are not triggered accidentally.
Do use the authored 1.75px stroke SVG icons from icons.ts for all actions.
donts: Don't use Unicode glyphs or emojis as UI icons.
Don't place kickers or eyebrows above headings inside the chatbox or dashboard.
Don't allow selection or unredacted screenshot capture of elements matching [data-feedback-ignore], [data-feedback-sensitive], input[type='password'], input[type='hidden'], or [autocomplete^='cc-'].
